profile.headline: Software Engineer | Startup Founder | Public Speaker
profile.summary: Former music teacher, band director, MIT programmer, wedding DJ, data scientist, and topic modeling researcher. I'm the CEO of Umanity: the first mobile philanthropic ecosystem. We forge connections and leverage resources in real-time between individuals, nonprofits, businesses, and those in need. As a company, we love connecting with those similarly seeking to advance the world's philanthropic technology.

positions.title: Founder, CEO
positions.description: As the owner of the company, my responsibilities include overseeing the fiscal activities of the company including budgeting, reporting and audits, assuring a work environment that recruits, retains and supports quality staff and volunteers including the process for selecting, development, motivating, and evaluating staff and volunteers, assuring the filing of all legal and regulatory documents and monitors compliance with relevant laws and regulations, while participating and overseeing the evolution of company level best practices, standards, and policies as it related to software development.

positions.title: Software Engineer/Data Scientist
positions.description: Currently, I add features to the company’s platform including searchable databases and improved mapping, coordinate between affiliated organizations to ensure accurate digital representation, strive to create a visually appealing site that feature user-friendly design and clear navigation, and write and implement algorithms for data mining and categorizing nation-wide tables, charts, images, and raw information.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: Working as a remote programmer, I would write programs using a variety of libraries and computer languages, update and expand existing programs, and debug programs by testing for and fixing errors  while cooperating with web designers to match visual design intent.

positions.title: Music Teacher/Band Director
positions.description: My responsibilities included providing an educational atmosphere in which students could move toward the fulfillment of their potential for intellectual, emotional, physical and psychological growth and develop skills as a performer and as one who appreciates and enjoys music.

positions.title: DJ/Instructor
positions.description:
Disc Jockey for Weddings, Clubs, Corporate Events, and Fashion Shows.

Educate local groups and individuals about the importance and craft of DJ'ing and producing.
